paite: TOUPA'N Aigupta gam ah Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen hi.
heading: Paikan
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

paite: Hiai kha noute a dia khate kipatna ahi ding. Noute a ding in kum khat a akha masapen ahi ding hi.
english: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

paite: Israel omkhawmte kiang ah thu gen in, hiai kha ani sawm ni in apipute inkuan dungzui zel in, michih in amah a ding in belamnou akilak chiat dia, inn khat zel a ding in belamnou khat zel.
english: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;

paite: Belamnou khat a dia inkuan atawm luatleh, ami phazah dungzui in amah leh a-inn zom a-invengte a toh lakhawm hen. Michih in akham ding bang zel in belamnou na sim ding uhi.
english: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.

paite: Na belamnou uh gensiatbei, apa kum khat a upa ahi dia; belamhon lak hiam kelte lak a pan in hiam na lakhe ding uhi.
english: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.

paite: Huai kha mah ani sawm-le-li tan na kem ding ua; nitaklam in Israel khawmpi omkhawmte'n agou ding uhi.
english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

paite: Asisan na la ding ua, anekna ding uh inn kongkhak biang khuam nihte ah leh kongkhak tung ah na tat ding uhi.
english: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

paite: Huai zan in sa mei a haimin, tanghou silngou soh louh toh na ne ding uhi; lou kha toh na ne ding uhi.
english: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.

paite: Sialnek kei unla, tuihuan het kei un, alutang, akhete leh asungkua toh mei ah na haimin zaw ding uhi.
english: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

paite: Azingchiang tan in bangmah na valsak kei ding uhi. Azingchiang tan a omlaite mei in na haltum ding uhi.
english: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

paite: Hichibang in na ne ding uhi. Na kawng uh gaksa in, na khedap uh na khe ua bulhsa in, na khut ua na chiangkhunte uh tawisa in na kin nek ding uhi. Hiai TOUPA Paikan Ankuang ahi.
english: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Tuzan chiang a Aigupta gamsung tawnsuak a, Aigupta gam a piang masa teng, mi leh ganta that ding ka hih ziak in, Aigupta pathiante tengteng siatna ding in ka vaihawm ding hi: Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am Yahweh.

paite: Sisan tuh noute a ding in na omna innte uah chiamtehna ahi ding. Sisan ka muh chiang in, ka hon paikan ding, Aigupta gam ka gawt chiang in, nou hon hihse ding in na tung uah hiai gawtna a-om kei ding hi.
english: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

paite: Hiai ni noute a ding in theihgige ahi ding. Na khang na khang un TOUPA kiang a ankuangluina in na nei ding ua; tangtawn in dan thuseh a ankuangluina in na nei ding uhi.
english: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

paite: "Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ua; ani masapen ni ngei in na innte ua pan in silngou na koihmang ding uhi. Ani masapen ni a kipan ani sagih ni tan, tanghou silngou soh ne peuhmah, huai mi Israel a pan satkhiak ding ahi ngal a.
heading: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang
english: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

paite: Ani masapen ni in kikhopna siangthou a-om dia, ani sagih ni in noute a ding in kikhopna siangthou a-om ding. Huai nite in nek bawl chih louh ngal nna sep louh himhim ding ahi. Nekbawl kia na hihthei ding uh.
english: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you.

paite: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na tang ding ua; hiai ni mah a Aigupta gam a kipan na mite ka pikhiak ziak in. Huaiziak in tangtawn in na khang un dan thuseh in hiai ni na tang ding uh ahi.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

paite: Akha khatna ah, huai kha ani sawm-le-li ni, nitaklam a kipan huai kha nitaklam ani sawmnih-le-khat matan in, tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uhi.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.

paite: Na insung uah ni sagih sung silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh silngou soh ne, huai mi ngei mikhual hiam hi in, agamsung a piang hitaleh Israel omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

paite: Silngou soh bangmah na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na tenna peuhmah uah tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uhi," achi hi.
english: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

paite: Mosi in Israel upate asamsak a, akiang uah, “Na inkuan dungzui zel un belamnou kaikhia in kilak unla, Paikan Belamnou gou un," achi hi.
heading: Paikan Masa
english: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.

paite: "Hissop gaklop na la ding ua, belkuang sung a om sisan ah na diah ding ua, belkuang sung a om sisan in kongkhak biang khuam tuak leh kongkhak tung na zep ding uhi. Zingsang masiah na lak ua kuamah a- inn kongkhak ah ava pawtkhe ding ahi kei;
english: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

paite: Aiguptate that dia TOUPA hong paisuak ding ahih ziak in. Kongkhak tung a leh kongbiang khuam nihte a sisan amuh chiang in TOUPA'N huai kongkhak apaikan dia, hon that ding in na insung uah hihsemi hong lut aphal kei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.

paite: Tangtawn in na tapate uh a ding leh noute a ding in dan thuseh in hiai thil na tang ding uh ahi.
english: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.

paite: Huan achiam bang a, nou ahon piak ding gam na tun chiang un, hichi ahi ding a, hiai biakna thilzek in na nei ding uh ahi.
english: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, na tate un na kiang ua, hiai biakna thilzek bang na chihna uh ahia? ahon chih chiang un,
english: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’

paite: 'Aiguptate athah a, ei innte atatkhiak lai a, Aigupta gam a Israel suante innte paikanpa, TOUPA paikanna theihgigena ahi, " na chi ding uh. Huchi in mite'n alu uh akunsak ua abeta uhi.
english: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.

paite: Israel suante apaimang ua, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron thu apiak bang in ahih ua, huchibang in amau leng ahihta uhi.
english: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zankim lai in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, alaltutphah tung a tu Pharaoh ta masapen a pan suangkul sung a om sal ta masapen tan in, ganhon nou masapen teng toh athatta hi.
heading: Piang Masate Sihna
english: At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

paite: Huchi in zan in Pharaoh athou a, amah leh asikhate leh Aigupta tengteng, Aigupta gamsung teng ah kahna thupitak a-omta a; inn khat mahmah mi khat sihlouhna a-om louh ziak in.
english: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

paite: Zan in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Thou unla, ka mite lak a pan paikhia un. Noute gel leh Israel suante pai un. Na gensa bang un, TOUPA nna va sem un.
english: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!

paite: Na bawnghonte uleh na ganhonte uh leng, na chih bang un, pi unla, paikhia un. Huchi in kei leng hon vualzawl un," achita hi.
english: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

paite: Kintak a gam a pan asawlkhiak theihna ding un Aiguptate'n mite anoh mahmah ua, "Si khin vek ding i hi uh," achih ziak un.
english: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”

paite: Mite'n atangbuang uh silngou soh ma in ala ua, aliangzang uah atangbuang haihnate uh puan a khihsawn in.
english: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

paite: Mosi thu bang in Israel suante a-omta ua; Aiguptate dangka suangmantam leh dangka-eng suangmantam leh puansilh angen uhi.
english: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

paite: Aiguptate mitmuh in TOUPA'N mite deihsakna apia a, adeih bang un huai thilte akiang uah apia uhi. Huchi in Aiguptate alok uhi.
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

paite: Israel suante Rameses a pan Sukkoth atung ua, numei leh naupangte sim louh pasal ngen khe a pai nuaiguk ahi uhi.
heading: Israelte'n Aigupta Anusia Uh
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.

paite: Mikihelte'n leng bawnghonte, ganhonte leh ganta tampi petmah toh amaute azuitou uhi.
english: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan apuakkhiak uh tangbuangte mek in silngou soh louh tanghou abawl ua, amaute Aigupta gam a kipan kintak a hawlkhiak a om, akizekaisak theih louh ziak un, atanghou uah silngou asoh man kei ua, lamkal a nek ding leng abuaipih man kei uhi.
english: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.

paite: Huchibang in Aigupta gam a teng, Israel suante taam sung kum zali-le-sawmthum ahi.
english: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

paite: Kum zali-le-sawmthum bei in hichi ahong hi a, huai ni ngei in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan TOUPA mi tengteng apaikheta uhi.
english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan amau apikhiak ziak in TOUPA a ding in huai zan zahtak petmah a tan ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA zan Israel suante'n akhang-akhang a, pilvangtak a atan ding uh ahi.
english: It is a night to be much observed to Yahweh for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of Yahweh, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai Paikan Ankuang zat ding a dan thuseh ahi. Mikhual in hiai anek louh ding ahi.
heading: Paikan Toh Kisai Dante
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

paite: Himahleh michih sikha sum a leisa, azek na sum nung in hiai ane thei ding hi.
english: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

paite: Gamdangmi leh sikha goihmi in hiai ane ding ahi kei hi.
english: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

paite: Inn khat a nek ding ahi; inn polam ah sa, abangmah na lathang ding uh ahi kei. Aguh leng na hihtan ding uh ahi kei.
english: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

paite: Israel omkhawmte tengteng in hiai azuih ding uh ahi.
english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

paite: Na kiang ua mikhual a-om a, TOUPA a dia Paikan Ankuang a-um dingleh, pasalte zek sum ding ahi, huai khit chiang in hong pai nai uhenla, um uhen. Amah gamsung a piang bang ahi ding; zeksum louh mi in anek louh ding ahih ziak in.
english: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to Yahweh, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the land; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

paite: Khotual mi a ding leh na lak ua mi khual taam a ding in dan khat a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
english: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”

paite: Huchibang in Israel suan tengteng in ahih uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
english: All the children of Israel did so. As Yahweh commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

paite: Huai ni mah in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawlpi in apikheta hi.
english: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
